Package com.eqixiac.equinix.design.optimizer.wizard.model

package com.eqixiac.equinix.design.optimizer.wizard.model
Value types for the Deployment Wizard — the plan itself and everything it is made of, plus the execution-side inputs and outcomes.

The centrepiece is DeploymentPlan (immutable; dryRun() returns a refreshed copy, execute(ExecutionInputs) does the provisioning). Its parts are the planned resources — PlannedCloudRouter, PlannedConnection, PlannedBackboneLink, PlannedRoutingProtocol — with the sizing/selection evidence (BandwidthAllocation, ProfileSelection, ProfileCandidate) and currency-honest pricing (PlanPricing — cross-currency totals are withheld, never fabricated).

Execution consumes ExecutionInputs (the customer-supplied authorization keys enumerated by ConnectionInputRequirement) and yields a DeploymentOutcome of ProvisionedResources and ProvisioningErrors. RouterBodies and ConnectionBodies are the single home of the wire-body shapes, so dry-runs and real creates send identical requests.

Most types here are Lombok @Value (get-prefixed accessors, builders, no setters).

    Description
    com.eqixiac.equinix.design.optimizer.wizard
    The Deployment Wizard: turns a metro OptimizationResult into an executable DeploymentPlan — Cloud Routers, provider connections, inter-metro backbone links, and routing protocols, with bandwidth-aware profile selection and honestly-reconciled pricing.
    com.eqixiac.equinix.design.optimizer.wizard.enums
    Configuration enums for the Deployment Wizard: BackboneTopology (how the recommended metros are meshed with inter-metro backbone links), BandwidthStrategy (how provider connections are sized from workload requirements), and ConnectionPurpose (what role a planned connection plays in the plan).
  • Classes
    Class
    Description
    BandwidthAllocation
    Bandwidth sizing breakdown for a single connection, showing how the total bandwidth requirement was derived from individual workload requirements under the configured BandwidthStrategy.
    ConnectionBodies
    Assembles a complete Fabric connection body from a PlannedConnection — both endpoints, encapsulation, and cloud authorization — so a live dry-run or a real create sends the whole request the API needs, not the endpoint-less name + bandwidth shell that Fabric rejects with EQ-3142501 "Null value for aSide access point".
    ConnectionInputRequirement
    The per-connection authorization a customer must gather before a provider connection can be provisioned.
    DeploymentOutcome
    The result of executing a deployment plan.
    DeploymentPlan
    A complete deployment plan generated by the Deployment Wizard.
    ExecutionInputs
    The customer-supplied, per-connection authorization a DeploymentPlan.execute(ExecutionInputs) run needs to provision cloud provider connections: the cloud-specific authentication key, the DOT1Q VLAN tag, and (for Azure ExpressRoute) the peering type.
    PlannedBackboneLink
    An inter-metro Fabric backbone link between two Cloud Routers, enabling private connectivity between deployment metros.
    PlannedCloudRouter
    A Cloud Router (FCR) to be created as part of a deployment plan.
    PlannedConnection
    A Fabric connection to be created as part of a deployment plan.
    PlannedRoutingProtocol
    A routing protocol configuration to be applied to a planned connection.
    PlanPricing
    Aggregated pricing breakdown for a complete deployment plan, including Cloud Router costs, provider connection costs, and backbone link costs.
    PlanValueAssessment
    Fluent builder, returned by DeploymentPlan.valueRealization(), that computes the egress savings a deployment plan unlocks once the caller declares their per-provider monthly egress volumes.
    PlanValueRealization
    The value-realization view of a DeploymentPlan: the monthly cloud-egress saving the plan's private interconnects unlock (versus public-internet egress), netted against the plan's actual Equinix interconnect cost.
    PlanValueRealization.ProviderEgressSaving
    The egress-saving row for one declared cloud provider: the internet-egress cost the declared volume would incur, the private-interconnect cost the plan enables instead, and the difference.
    ProfileCandidate
    One service profile that can carry a given connection's bandwidth, as a typed decision point the wizard exposes instead of silently picking.
    ProfileSelection
    How the wizard chose a service profile and a billable bandwidth for one provider connection — the bandwidth-aware selection made visible rather than hidden.
    ProvisionedResource
    A single resource that was created during deployment execution — the audit-trail entry a DeploymentOutcome carries for every create that succeeded, including resources that were subsequently torn down by an abort-and-rollback.
    ProvisioningError
    An error recorded while executing a deployment plan — a resource that could not be provisioned, a pre-flight or waiter observation, or a rollback deletion that failed.
    RouterBodies
    Assembles a complete Fabric Cloud Router body from a PlannedCloudRouter — name, metro, package, the optional account/project references, and the mandatory notification recipients — mirroring ConnectionBodies for connections.
